content.title: Constricted Interior Escape | Mounted Impacts and Open Release
content.summary: A courier on a mechanical deer breaks from a conservatory into daylight. Preserve the five causal invariants and terminal proof while replacing every source-specific surface.

quick_start.input_format: One adult rider and one carrier remain attached. + Every impact alters the established interior route. + Damage persists after the pair passes. + Escalation moves from narrow obstacles to one final opening. + The terminal release preserves the origin space as aftermath.
quick_start.recommended_input: Place one clearly adult original animated courier with a silver braid and blue cape on a white mechanical deer inside a glass conservatory hall. One shoulder impact breaks a thin plaster partition and leaves a readable deer-shaped opening. Let deer and courier exit through that single window into open daylight, leaving the damaged hall and one clear route behind.
required_anchors: One adult rider and one carrier remain attached.
Every impact alters the established interior route.
Escalation moves from narrow obstacles to one final opening.
The terminal release preserves the origin space as aftermath.
usage_steps: Replace the example subject, setting, and surface details with an original concept.
Keep every required anchor and Creative DNA invariant causally visible.
Choose the MiniMax H3 or Seedance 2.0 prompt and fill only the declared variable slots.
Check duration, event order, camera continuity, sound, and anti-copy constraints before generation.
applicable_scope: A courier on a mechanical deer breaks from a conservatory into daylight. Preserve the five causal invariants and terminal proof while replacing every source-specific surface.
Original 4–15 second concepts that can preserve every required anchor.
MiniMax H3 or Seedance 2.0 projects that need a reusable causal video structure.
not_suitable_for: Requests that copy the source identity, setting, props, dialogue, or shot order.
Concepts that cannot show all required anchors inside the target duration.
Long-form exposition or unrelated multi-location stories without a compact causal chain.

invariants.rule: One adult rider and one carrier remain attached.
invariants.purpose: Establishes the baseline identity, object or geography that every later state must preserve.
invariants.ablation_failure: Without this exact baseline rule, later changes cannot be attributed to the same subject, object or place, so the sequence loses its reference state. Removed rule: "One adult rider and one carrier remain attached."

invariants.rule: Every impact alters the established interior route.
invariants.purpose: Makes the visible trigger precede and explain the first mechanism response.
invariants.ablation_failure: Without this exact trigger rule, the response appears spontaneously and the central cause-and-effect claim is no longer demonstrated. Removed rule: "Every impact alters the established interior route."

invariants.rule: Damage persists after the pair passes.
invariants.purpose: Keeps the middle progression registered instead of allowing an unexplained reset.
invariants.ablation_failure: Without this exact progression rule, the middle can jump to a replacement state and the accumulated result is no longer traceable. Removed rule: "Damage persists after the pair passes."

invariants.rule: Escalation moves from narrow obstacles to one final opening.
invariants.purpose: Reconnects the changed or partial state to the established subject and spatial anchor.
invariants.ablation_failure: Without this exact reconnection rule, detail or transformed shots can belong to a different subject or geography and continuity cannot be verified. Removed rule: "Escalation moves from narrow obstacles to one final opening."

invariants.rule: The terminal release preserves the origin space as aftermath.
invariants.purpose: Turns the terminal hold into observable proof that the mechanism completed.
invariants.ablation_failure: Without this exact terminal-proof rule, the sequence stops on motion alone and never confirms the promised outcome or preserved aftermath. Removed rule: "The terminal release preserves the origin space as aftermath."
